description: This file implements authentication middleware and utility functions for handling JSON Web Tokens (JWTs), as well as ensuring a default admin user exists. It defines functions for requiring authentication, signing user tokens, and initializing a default admin user based on environment variables.

methods.name: authRequired(req, res, next)
methods.description: Express middleware that validates a Bearer JWT from the request headers and attaches the decoded user information to req.user.

methods.name: signUserToken(user)
methods.description: Generates a signed JWT for a user payload containing id, email, role, and name with an expiration of 7 days.

methods.name: ensureDefaultAdmin()
methods.description: Asynchronously checks if a default admin user exists; if not, creates one using environment-specified credentials and logs a message.
